summary: CMEK organization policy constraints let organizations enforce Cloud SQL use of customer-managed encryption keys and restrict allowed key projects.
extended_definition: CMEK organization policy constraints let organizations enforce Cloud SQL use of customer-managed encryption keys and restrict allowed key projects.

supporting_pages.title: "Data residency overview \_|\_ Cloud SQL for SQL Server \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: You can use organizational policy constraints to enforce data residency requirements at the organization, project, or folder level.
CMEK are intended for organizations that have sensitive or regulated data that requires them to manage their own encryption keys.
You can enforce this constraint even if the user is authorized according to your Google Cloud IAM policy .

supporting_pages.title: Create instances \_|\_ Cloud SQL for SQL Server \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Note: Some organizations use an organization policy to restrict resource locations.
Note: If there is a resource location constraint on your organization policy, you must select one of the regions that the organization policy allows.
If this type of policy affects your project, you can only select regions the organization policy allows.

supporting_pages.title: "Choose your backup option \_|\_ Cloud SQL for SQL Server \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: The following table provides an overview of the key features available with each backup option: Features Standard backups Enhanced backups Centralized backup management across projects - ✔ Backup vault - ✔ Automated backup schedule Daily Hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly On-demand backups ✔ ✔ Multi-region backups ✔ ✔ Final backup in instance deletion ✔ ✔ Backup retention period 1 year 10 years Retain all backups on instance deletion ✔ ✔ Retain backups on project deletion - ✔ Enforced retention with retention lock - ✔ Point-in-time recovery using logs ✔ ✔ Point-in-time recovery after instance deletion ✔ ✔ Cross-region backup and restore ✔ - CMEK support ✔ - For detailed information about these backup options, see Standard backups and Enhanced backups .
If your organization has this type of requirement, it probably uses a Resource Location Restriction organizational policy .

In a multi-region configuration, it's recommended that backups be in the same region as the instance to minimize latency and avoid potential backup failures due to organization policies, or location-based limitations.
